sections.title: Work
paragraphs: mesh. — Core Builder. October 2026–present; member since December 2024.

Physics Olympiad School — Physics Instructor and Organizer. Teach olympiad physics; private physics and mathematics tutoring since November 2023. Physics tutor and coach to a member of Austria's International Physics Olympiad (IPhO) team.

sections.title: Education
paragraphs: Eötvös Loránd University (ELTE). B.Sc. in Physics, 2025–2028 (expected graduation). GPA: 5.0/5.0.
Baár-Madas Reformed High School, Budapest. Mathematics track, 2019–2025. Pro Schola Award, the school's highest distinction.

sections.title: International Olympiads
paragraphs: International Physics Olympiad (IPhO): bronze medals in 2022, 2023 and 2025.
European Physics Olympiad (EuPhO): silver in 2024; bronze in 2022 and 2023.
European Olympiad of Experimental Science (EOES): gold, 2nd overall, in 2023; silver in 2024.

sections.title: Hungarian National Olympiads
paragraphs: National High School Olympiads (OKTV). Physics, Category II: 1st in 2024; 2nd in 2025. Mathematics, Category II: 11th in 2024. Biology, Category I: 12th in 2025.
